Those products are in Spanish, priced in euros, and based on Spanish regulation, so they suit readers who adapt them to their own market.

tools.title: Free tools to try before you buy
tools.sub: No purchase needed: open them in your browser and get an answer in minutes.

items.q: What do I get when I buy a digital product?
items.a: You get the spreadsheets, templates and guide of that product, with instant download and lifetime access to a private dashboard where updates appear at no extra cost. It is a one-time payment, with no subscription, and every product includes a satisfaction guarantee whose exact terms are on its product page.

items.q: Do the spreadsheets work in Excel and Google Sheets?
items.a: Yes. Every spreadsheet is built to work in Microsoft Excel and Google Sheets with no macros. You can open the same file in either platform and keep all settings working.

items.q: Do the products work in the US, UK, Canada, and Australia?
items.a: Yes. Currency, sales tax or VAT, and units are settings inside the spreadsheet, so one product serves different countries. Where regulation matters, the food safety pack will include a US FDA Food Code annex and a UK FSA annex for the 14 allergens.

items.q: How do currency and payment work?
items.a: Products are priced in USD, and checkout shows your local currency in the UK, Canada, and other countries. You can pay by card, Apple Pay, or Google Pay through Stripe.

items.q: Do I need an AI Chef Pro subscription?
items.a: No. Digital products are a one-time purchase and do not require a subscription to the AI Chef Pro platform. You buy them, download them, and use them on your own.

items.q: When will the first English product be available?
items.a: The Recipe Costing Kit is in production and launching soon, though we don’t have a date to share yet. Meanwhile, you can use the free Food Cost Calculator on the site to start working on your recipe costs.

The Spanish store already has 50 products for Spanish-speaking hospitality professionals, including the Hispanic workforce in the US and Latin America. They are in Spanish, priced in euros, and based on Spanish regulation, so they suit readers who adapt them to their own market.
